sources.title: NASA spatial convergence tutorial
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: Nek5000：譜元素階數、局部節點與全域自由度
related.titleEn: Nek5000: spectral-element order, local nodes and global degrees of freedom
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告包含未通過資料與限制；外插值不能標示為量測真值。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The report preserves failed data and limitations; an extrapolated value is not labeled measured truth.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「Nek5000：譜元素階數、局部節點與全域自由度」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付局部節點帳本、介面共享圖、純量與向量容量表及 p 精化證據。
related.differenceEn: Investigate Nek5000: spectral-element order, local nodes and global degrees of freedom using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver local-node ledgers, an interface-sharing diagram, scalar and vector capacity tables and p-refinement evidence that does not conflate local storage with global degrees of freedom.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 計算相鄰差 0.12 與 0.03，再以 log2 四取得二；檢查單調性與差值符號。
將單元素值數乘一百，再對次數九重做；以十除八的三次方核對比例。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate adjacent differences 0.12 and 0.03, then obtain order two from log2 of four. Check monotonicity and signs before using an order formula that assumes the supplied convergence pattern.
Multiply the single-element count by one hundred and repeat at degree nine. Independently check the ratio using ten divided by eight, cubed, and keep scalar-value counts distinct from byte counts.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MUMPS：填充比、消去排序與前緣記憶體
related.titleEn: MUMPS: fill ratios, elimination ordering and frontal memory
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告包含未通過資料與限制；外插值不能標示為量測真值。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The report preserves failed data and limitations; an extrapolated value is not labeled measured truth.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「MUMPS：填充比、消去排序與前緣記憶體」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付排序與消去樹摘要、填充表、前緣生命期與同精度成本比較。
related.differenceEn: Investigate MUMPS: fill ratios, elimination ordering and frontal memory using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver ordering and elimination-tree summaries, fill tables, frontal lifetimes and equal-accuracy cost comparisons that keep symbolic estimates distinct from numerical-factorization observations.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 計算相鄰差 0.12 與 0.03，再以 log2 四取得二；檢查單調性與差值符號。
將二十五萬除五萬，並畫原稀疏圖與新增填充示意；說明填充來源是消去產生的新耦合。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate adjacent differences 0.12 and 0.03, then obtain order two from log2 of four. Check monotonicity and signs before using an order formula that assumes the supplied convergence pattern.

Divide two hundred fifty thousand by fifty thousand and sketch original sparsity plus illustrative fill edges. Explain how elimination creates new couplings rather than assuming every factor entry existed in the original matrix.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
